exceptions.evidence: At basis 1916 both practice sources are unrated single radio fields. Only the indefinite coth-substitution and definite sinh-substitution banks are observed. This package validates authored easy/moderate peer workloads only; no hard template has been specified or validated. Absence of source labels is not proof that hard questions are impossible. New source or validated workload evidence reopens classification.

finite_policy: Integer n=2..12 inclusive in each independent family; 11 tasks each, including the original task which is excluded from replenishment. Indefinite varies the denominator coefficient; definite varies the upper endpoint. No extra diversity from choice order, UUID, seed, solution wording or bank profile. Future exhaustion must report finite-limit with unmet counts.
